summary: The candidate is mathematically correct with no gaps. The barycentric merging argument applies to the union of all optimal supports and proves both the empty lattice hull and the intrinsic parity bound. The finite-dimensional cone argument establishes a strict supporting dual, including entries forced to zero by the constraints. Its equality cells give lattice-convex row supports containing their targets. Strict concavity and the perturbation argument establish the unique entropy maximizer and its exact support. Stationarity on that support gives finite multipliers, and the active-set inclusion at positive barycenters has the correct direction for the weighted Holder inequality. This proves convex-admissibility of the share potential, log-concavity of each row, and the stated cost comparison. The convex-roof construction retains every lattice zero and remains valid in lower affine rank, including rank zero. The normalization agrees with accepted fact 488f0a583886b5fc. Singleton, boundary-target, structural-zero, and arbitrary finite positive-coefficient cases are all covered.
